crm.title: CRM Integration (HubSpot)
crm.hubspotDescription: Configure the connection to HubSpot to automatically sync contacts, deals and activities from phone interviews. The API key needs permissions for Contacts, Deals and Tasks.
crm.apiKeyExtra: Your HubSpot private app API key (starts with 'pat-')
crm.portalIdExtra: Your Hub ID, visible in HubSpot settings
crm.defaultPipelineExtra: Pipeline ID to use for deals (e.g. 'default')
crm.syncContactsExtra: Create or update HubSpot contacts from callers
crm.syncDealsExtra: Create a deal for every completed call
crm.createFollowupTasksExtra: Automatically create tasks for post-call follow-up
crm.howToGetApiKey: How to get the API Key
crm.guideStep1: Log in to your HubSpot account
crm.guideStep2: Go to Settings → Integrations → Private Apps
crm.guideStep3: Create a new Private App or use an existing one
crm.guideStep4: Make sure it has: Contacts (Read/Write), Deals (Read/Write), Tasks (Read/Write) permissions
crm.howToFindPortalId: How to find the Portal ID and Pipeline
crm.guideStep6: The Portal ID (Hub ID) is under Settings → Account Setup → Account Defaults
crm.guideStep7: To find Pipeline and Stage IDs: Settings → Objects → Deals → Pipelines
crm.guideStep8: The IDs are visible in the URL or via HubSpot's API

calendar.completeAuth: Complete authentication in the popup window
calendar.title: Calendar Integration
calendar.googleDescription: Automatically creates Google Calendar events for every call. Requires a Google Cloud project with the Google Calendar API enabled.
calendar.googleClientIdExtra: Client ID from Google Cloud Console
calendar.googleClientSecretExtra: Client Secret from Google Cloud Console
calendar.calendarIdExtra: ID of the calendar to use (default: 'primary' for the main calendar)
calendar.googleStep2: Create a new project or select an existing one
calendar.copyClientIdSecret: Copy Client ID and Client Secret
calendar.microsoftDescription: Automatically creates Microsoft Outlook/365 calendar events for every call. Requires an app registered in Azure AD.
calendar.msTenantIdExtra: Tenant ID from Azure AD (use 'common' for multi-tenant)
calendar.msCalendarIdExtra: Calendar ID (leave empty for default calendar)
calendar.msStep5: Supported account types: choose based on your needs
calendar.msStep7: After creating it, go to "Certificates & secrets" → create a Client Secret
calendar.msStep8: Go to "API permissions" → "Add permission" → "Microsoft Graph" → "Delegated" → add: Calendars.ReadWrite, offline_access
calendar.msStep9: Copy the Application ID, Tenant ID and Client Secret value

telephonyTab.confirmDisconnectDescription: Deregisters the number from xAI - it will stop answering until you reconnect it.

telephonyTab.elevenDescription: Provisions or updates this project's Eleven v3 Conversational agent and prepares the Zadarma switch to the ElevenLabs SIP trunk, with rollback instructions.

pdfEmailTab.title: PDF Report and Email after the call
pdfEmailTab.description: After every completed call, Ascolta can automatically generate a PDF report from the extracted data (and send it by email, if mail is configured system-wide). Turn it off for projects that don't need it.
pdfEmailTab.templateTooltip: The template determines how the data extracted from the call is presented

calcomTab.title: Appointment bookings (Cal.com)
calcomTab.description: Which Cal.com event types this project uses. The API key is configured at the tenant level, on the Credentials page - here only what's specific to this project. Regenerate the runtime instance (Projects, lightning icon) after saving.
calcomTab.defaultEventTypeIdTooltip: Used when the prompt doesn't distinguish between standard/sport visit type
calcomTab.standardEventTypeIdTooltip: Used by the tool when the prompt requests a regular visit (appointment_type: standard)
calcomTab.sportEventTypeIdTooltip: Used by the tool when the prompt requests a sports/competitive certificate (appointment_type: sport)

knowledgeBase.confirmDeleteSource: Delete this source and its chunks?
knowledgeBase.title: Project knowledge base
knowledgeBase.description: The voice agent consults these sources during the call (search_knowledge_base tool) to answer specific questions - hours, procedures, news, regulations. Add a URL to crawl (automatically detects sites built on the kPortal/AGID template, with a dedicated content API) or upload a document.
knowledgeBase.maxPagesTooltip: How many pages to index at most on each run
knowledgeBase.autoRecrawlTooltip: Leave empty for a one-time indexing - you can still relaunch it manually with 'Reindex'
knowledgeBase.autoRecrawlDisableTooltip: Leave empty to disable auto recrawl

simulateChat.simulationDescription: This is not a real voice call, and it has no access to the knowledge base or other tools - it's for checking tone and content of the replies before publishing.
simulateChat.emptyStateHint: Write a message the way a caller would, to see how it responds.

projects.generateRuntimeTooltip: Generate runtime service (config + systemd, like earlier-prototype) - super admin only
projects.confirmDeactivateDescription: The project will no longer be usable, but will remain in the database and can be reactivated.
projects.confirmReactivateDescription: The project will become visible and usable again.
projects.credentialsExceptionNote: For exceptions only: these credentials apply only to this project and take precedence over everything else. Normally nothing needs to be configured here — the project automatically inherits the tenant's API keys (Tenant → Credentials); only if the tenant has none is the global .env fallback used.
projects.provisionDescription: Config, credentials (from the tenant/project Credentials Manager) and systemd unit have been written to disk. The app has no root permissions: run these commands on the server to activate the service.
projects.noTemplateAssignedDescription: Your tenant doesn't have any template assigned yet - contact a super admin to have one assigned from the Templates page.
projects.templateCopyNote: Copies the prompt, opening line, voice, language and output configuration from the template. Phone number and credentials still need to be connected separately for the new project.

projectEdit.elevenLlmUpdated: ElevenLabs model updated on the real agent
projectEdit.elevenLlmUpdateError: Could not update the ElevenLabs model
projectEdit.draftSaved: Draft saved - publish to make it active for calls
projectEdit.openingSaved: Opening line saved - publish to make it active for calls
projectEdit.variablesSaved: Variables saved - publish to make them active for calls
projectEdit.draftReverted: Draft reverted to the published version (v{{version}})
projectEdit.conversationPromptDescription: This prompt guides the AI during the phone call. It includes instructions on how to lead the conversation, what questions or information to provide, and how to handle the caller's responses.
projectEdit.noVariablesYet: none yet - write {{nome}} in the prompt and "Add as variable" appears below
projectEdit.alreadyAvailable: Already available, no need to configure them:
projectEdit.callerIdExplanation: the caller's number - provided by the voice provider, Ascolta doesn't touch it
projectEdit.currentDatetimeSentence: Use current_datetime as the single source of truth for the current date, time and day of the week in Rome.
projectEdit.currentDatetimeExplanation: a tool the model calls on its own to know the current date/time - just mention it in the prompt in a sentence, it should not be written between {{ }}
projectEdit.tagWithoutValueDescription: These {{tag}} appear in the prompt but have no defined variable - they stay as is, literally visible to callers, until you add them (or remove them from the prompt).
projectEdit.tagWithoutValueDescriptionShort: These {{tag}} appear in the prompt but have no defined variable.
projectEdit.extractionPromptDescription: This prompt is used to extract structured information from the call transcript. It defines the output JSON format and the fields to extract.
projectEdit.noVersionPublished: No version published yet - this project doesn't yet answer any real calls
projectEdit.step1of2: Step 1 of 2: you have unsaved changes in the tabs below. Click "Save draft" in the tab you changed, then come back here to publish them.
projectEdit.step2of2: Step 2 of 2: the saved draft is ready but not yet active. Real calls keep using the published version above until you click "Publish".
projectEdit.draftMatchesPublished: The draft matches the published version exactly - what you see here is what callers hear, no action needed.
projectEdit.confirmRevertDescription: The draft (saved or not) reverts to exactly what callers hear right now - the changes made here are lost.
projectEdit.elevenLlmDescription: List synced from the ElevenLabs workspace. The change is applied immediately to the phone agent.
projectEdit.firstHeardDescription: The first sentence spoken by the agent at the start of the call, before the caller says anything. Part of the same draft/publish flow as the prompts below.
projectEdit.openingLinePlaceholder: E.g. Hello, how can I help you?
projectEdit.variableValuesTitle: Values for the {{...}} tags used in the prompt
projectEdit.variableValuesDescription: Some come from the template this project was created from, others you add yourself (a notice appears below the editor when you write a new {{tag}}). Changing a value here doesn't change the prompt text - it counts at publish time.
projectEdit.emailPdfDescription: Send PDF by email after the call
projectEdit.outputConfigNote: Output configuration is managed from the project's Settings tab.
